mission.title: Inside Job
mission.description: Collect the Oracle's whereabouts from a Zion terminal, spy on her guard captain, steal his guard roster, and pass it to the assassin's backup contact.

npc.say: Hm. Touche. I'll see you, and raise one Archaeopteryx.
What? No, no. If you want the step, it's elevate...twist...kick...flair. See? Anyone can do it.

phase.briefing:
That idiot General is finally out of the Matrix, and out of my hair, although his moronic foot-dragging at the station may have cost us the Trainman.
While our Squiddy leader is lying low in that sludge-pit you call a world, operative, we have work to do; the Merovingian still wants the Oracle dead, after all.
The kill-code has already been transferred through the Zion networks to our undercover assassin. This person has returned some necessary data. You will collect it from the Zion terminal at that location.

enter.say: Uh-oh... Looks like that place is on alert for some reason.

done.say: There goes the alarm...and any cover you might have had left.

objective.text: Get the Data from the Computer

done.say: Okay, get that to a hardline--pronto!

objective.text: Upload the Data at a hardline

phase.briefing:
Mm, yes, Zion may have found out about the transfer of the kill-code into their network. I suppose that might have their network security somewhat on edge.
The data you retrieved included the address where Zion is currently hiding the Oracle. You may be wondering why we don't try a frontal assault. Remember that we only get one shot with the kill-code; an all-out attack would be detected before we could get the Oracle in our sights. It hardly takes magical powers to anticipate such a crude maneuver.
No, I'm sending you there on your own--to reconnoiter. All you have to do is identify--and get a voice print of--the Zion guard captain on duty.

enter.say:
That's the place. The Oracle's probably in there somewhere. Oh, geez--what if we run into Seraph?
I'm definitely reading redpills patrolling the area.

objective.text: Get a voice print of the guard captain

done.say: All right, got their voice and face recorded. That's all we need.

near.say: The far door is sealed... Aha! And judging by the chevrons, that's got to be the captain on duty: Campbell!

complete.say: You're not getting in here without clearance. This is a restricted area!
That's great, but it doesn't get the door open...and from the looks of things it's bringing massive hostile reinforcements your way. You need to get out of there.

phase.briefing:
The captain should have access to the roster of the Oracle's guard detail, which our assassin will need, since they'll be posing as one of her guards in order to get close to her.
You'll have to break into Campbell's files. This should be easy, even for you, since our inside team who got the kill-code through their network has already cracked the security at the terminal you're about to access.

enter.say:
Looks quiet in there. You should have a clear shot at that computer.
I gotta say, I have a little bone to pick with the "inside team" about tipping off Zion's network security. This whole thing would'a been a lot easier without that security alert at the last terminal.

done.say: Ah-ha, there we go. Grab that data, and get outta there.

objective.text: Get the Data from the Computer

done.say: Wuh-oh. We just did something they didn't like; you got incoming.

phase.briefing:
There...do appear to have been some problems with the network sabotage team, {player}. In fact... Ah... They've been caught. Well, that does complicate this somewhat.
Just a moment, please. I'm making arrangements...
Very well. You are to deposit the data with our assassin's backup contact. It's unfortunate that we have to involve them so soon, but...they knew the risks. You'll find the contact at the marked location; they'll respond to the code-word "Pterodactyl" with the countersign "Amber."

enter.say:
Looks like some kind of Exile party in there. Uh... I'm sure you'll fit right in.
...
Maybe spike your hair up a bit.

talk.say: Amber. Watch out you don't get stuck.

done.say:
It's her! Wasserman is the contact. Give her the data.
Unless "Amber" was just a random response... Na-ah... What're the odds?

talk.say: Stop fooling around, and give me the data. What's the big idea with that get-up? Are you trying to blow my cover?

done.say: All right. You should probably...uh...get out of there.

complete.say: Nice to meet you, stranger. Too bad you couldn't...stick around.

mission.finish:
Well, with any luck that information will give our assassin just what they need to work their way into the Oracle's own guard detail, and then... Pow.
No, operative, I was making a pistol shape with my fingers, and... Oh, never mind.
